purpose: Verify local official registry/cadastre evidence and inspect anonymous public map HTML/static JS/schema and geometry-safe routes for city parcel coverage.
scopeLimits: Reviewed official city government SPP description, the city land-registration-office administrative-map page, and indexed ArcGIS portal metadata. The city office map is described as administrative; the SPP is described as land and planning lookup. No map identify, address, legal parcel identifier, owner field, login, or record query was attempted.
assessment: The official city SPP/GIS host and the official land-registration-office subdomain fail direct anonymous DNS resolution from this client, with no HTTP response. The public indexed SPP description confirms land-information and planning lookups, but the indexed ArcGIS Instant Apps item prompts the visitor to sign in. No anonymous feature layer, public parcel schema, or geometry-only service could be directly verified.
registryAssessment: The official Cần Thơ Land Registration Office identifies its cadastral registration role and publishes an administrative map page. A city government article describes the city Spatial Planning Platform (SPP) at gis.cantho.gov.vn as providing land-information and land-use-planning lookups, and reports land-information GIS layers and VBDLIS deployment. The advertised SPP is not evidence of anonymous parcel-vector access.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Cần Thơ Land Registration Office page titled “Administrative map”; identifies the authoring/updating office and contact. Search/open indexed content was accessible, while direct GET failed DNS resolution.

Official city Party Committee article says the city SPP at gis.cantho.gov.vn supports land-information and land-use-planning lookups; it reports 16 GIS layers from the natural-resources department and VBDLIS operation in 6/9 localities at that time. It does not describe an anonymous parcel-vector endpoint.
Indexed official ArcGIS Instant Apps page displays a sign-in prompt for the item; direct requests to the gis.cantho.gov.vn host could not resolve, so no HTTP status is claimed.

searchQueries.query: Cần Thơ cổng GIS SPP tra cứu thông tin đất đai bản đồ địa chính thửa đất
searchQueries.result: Found the official city SPP description and official city land-registration-office administrative map. Direct map host DNS failure prevented inspection of HTML/JS/schema.

searchQueries.query: Can Tho official land registration office cadastral map parcel GIS
searchQueries.result: Found the city land-registration-office map page and ArcGIS portal references; no anonymous parcel vector route verified.

viewerAndServiceTrace.geometryDisposition: No parcel geometry retained; no anonymous geometry-only route verified.
viewerAndServiceTrace.panGridReason: No anonymous map client, schema, or geometry-safe route was reachable; the only advertised map item prompts for sign-in.

geometryDecision: No qualifying anonymous parcel polygon geometry was obtained or retained.
privacy: No credentials, owner names, addresses, personal records, parcel identifiers, Khatian data, or property-detail lookups were submitted. Static schema and route names were inspected only where publicly exposed.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the city SPP or a VBDLIS instance provides an anonymous geometry-only map when accessed from a resolving browser/network; whether the advertised layer set contains parcel vectors rather than planning/land-information summaries.
nextStep: Root review; no runtime source adapter or global registry/catalog change is justified by the verified geometry evidence.
